column1: # Intentional TDD-red DRIVERS. Three TAB-separated fields:
# <driver-name> is the name a suite runner prints in its per-driver verdict
# line (VERDICT<TAB><name><TAB><PASS|RED|FAIL>) — a single driver, never a
# suite. precommit/gate.sh refuses a row that names a whole suite, a row
# whose tracking issue is CLOSED, and a row older than the staleness horizon
# Remove the row the moment the driver goes green. An unlisted failing
# History (issue #141): this file used to carry one row, `suite`, pointing
# at issue #61 — closed weeks before. `suite` was the entire unit + stress
# run plus all four bench gates, so that one row turned every failure of
# everything into "RED (known-red, TDD)" and let the commit through. It
# carried a real use-after-free into main: PR #136 dismissed a reproducible
# post-PASS SIGSEGV as covered by it, and PR #139 root-caused the SIGSEGV as
# a genuine UAF. The row is gone and the gate is per-driver now.
